edges.reason: transfer forwards execution to transferFrom with msg.sender as the source.
transferFrom calls ensure to validate the transfer is allowed.
ensure calls condition for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the authoritative pair address.
delegate executes an arbitrary delegatecall on user supplied target and data.
transferFrom subtracts _value from balanceOf[_from] without SafeMath.
batchSend computes _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication.
init multiplies token and maxToken by 10**decimals without overflow checks.
Constructor assigns ownership to the caller msg.sender.
delegate is gated only by require(msg.sender == owner).
init is gated only by require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend is gated only by require(msg.sender == owner).
setTradeAddress is gated only by require(msg.sender == owner).
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is validated and decremented in transferFrom.
approve writes the allowance entry keyed by msg.sender as owner.
transfer passes msg.sender as the sender into transferFrom.
The delegatecall can arbitrarily rewrite storage such as the canSale whitelist mapping.
Parameter _to of transfer flows into the call to transferFrom.
Parameter _value of transfer flows into the call to transferFrom.
Parameter _from of ensure is compared against whitelisted addresses.
Parameter _value of ensure is passed into condition.
Parameter _from of transferFrom indexes balanceOf and allowance.
Parameter _to of transferFrom is credited balanceOf[_to] += _value.
Parameter _value of transferFrom drives the balance and allowance bookkeeping.
Parameter _spender of approve keys the allowance mapping.
Parameter _value of approve becomes the stored allowance.
Parameter a of delegate is the delegatecall target address.
Parameter b of delegate is the delegatecall calldata payload.
Parameter saleNum of init is stored into _saleNum.
Parameter token of init is multiplied by 10**decimals without overflow protection.
Parameter maxToken of init is scaled and stored into _maxSale.
_tos.length participates in the unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length.
Parameter _value of batchSend is credited to every recipient.
Parameter _value of batchSend is multiplied by the recipient count without checks.
Local total stores the unchecked product used to debit the sender balance.
Loop index i controls the batchSend distribution loop.
Loop-local _to receives tokens and emits Transfer events in batchSend.
Parameter addr of setTradeAddress is written by the owner.
Parameter addr is assigned to the tradeAddress state variable.
Parameter factory is hashed into the pair address computation.
Parameter tokenA is hashed into the pair address computation.
Parameter tokenB is hashed into the pair address computation.
Local _UNI derived in ensure is compared against _from as a trusted address.
owner is compared against _from and _to to bypass the sale condition.
owner is read in the require(msg.sender == owner) guard of delegate.
owner is read in the require(msg.sender == owner) guard of init.
owner is read in the require(msg.sender == owner) guard of batchSend.

balanceOf is read and written directly in batchSend.

canSale whitelist is consulted in ensure to bypass conditions.
_minSale bounds the transfer value in condition.

totalSupply is assigned in the constructor.

name is assigned from the constructor argument.
symbol is assigned from the constructor argument.
UNI constant is treated as a trusted sender in ensure.
